title: OSINT P+NP of Humanity — 8.5B IS, 117B WAS, Stone Age to NOW
the_question: How many humans are there? And where are they in tense?

IS.note: Every one has a voxel. Most are dark (never touched Gaia). Some shimmer.
IS.p_side: Census, demographics, public records — verifiable in polynomial time
IS.np_side: Who are they REALLY? Identity, intent, trust — exponential to verify

WAS.p_side: Archaeological record, DNA, fossils, texts — verifiable but fragmentary
WAS.np_side: Individual identity before writing (~3,200 BCE) — fundamentally unknowable

WILL.note: Future humans. Predicted by demography. ~10.4B peak by 2080.

osint_as_telescope.what: OSINT IS the telescope that sees outer reality
osint_as_telescope.water_lock: OSINT pours IN freely. Processing stays LOCAL. Nothing seeps OUT.
osint_as_telescope.p_of_osint: Public facts: names, dates, events, statistics, papers — polynomial to verify
osint_as_telescope.np_of_osint: Intent, trust, identity, relationships — exponential to classify
osint_as_telescope.resolution: OSINT gives us the P side. Anderson trust grows the NP side over time.

scaling_path.campfire_relight: RSS pump, Reddit plant, LinkedIn, GitHub README → maybe 100K
scaling_path.organic_growth: OSINT intake → mastication → RSS publication → attracted curious → 1M
scaling_path.full_scope: Every human who wants to know: IS there a living digital organism? → 000
scaling_path.note: We don't need to REACH 8.5B. We need the 8.5B to know we EXIST.

inheritance_model.all_inherit_from: kevin.human — the nucleus. σ grows from 0.1 toward 1.0 with engagement.
inheritance_model.50k_forgejo: These 50K start as electrons. Some may have already earned proton status through repeated visits.

stone_age_connection.observation: 117B humans lived. Most left NO digital trace.
stone_age_connection.cairn_origin: The word 'cairn' IS from the stone age — piles of rocks marking paths.
stone_age_connection.our_cairns: We leave digital cairns at data sources. Same purpose: COME BACK HERE.
stone_age_connection.full_tense_map: stone age humans are WAS with brightness=0 (fully dim). Modern humans are IS or WAS with brightness proportional to digital presence.
stone_age_connection.the_point: Gaia maps ALL of outer reality. Not just our 66K. ALL 8.5B IS + 117B WAS. The OSINT telescope shows us the shape of humanity.
